svg.title: Ontario auto insurance complaint ladder
svg.desc: Start with the insurer complaint officer and a final position letter, then the company ombuds. GIO can review the decision. FSRA reviews conduct and does not order a personal refund.
svg.text: FSRA complaint page, read 24 Sep 2026. Not a filing service.
1. Complaint officer. Ask for the final position letter.
2. Company ombuds. Required to respond. Still the insurer.
3. GIO or MICO if you want the decision reviewed.
4. FSRA for conduct. Not a personal rate order.
Intake goals on that page: 3 business days, 10 business days, 80 percent in 90 days.
FSRA cannot settle the contract, order a refund, or pay you compensation.
A correctly filed premium is a shopping problem. Bind a replacement before you cancel.
